spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grids with gap-8 to gap-12, visible border lines for editorial feel
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for typography, optical alignment for buttons/icons
spacing_and_layout.editorial_lists: flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between border-b border-[#E5E5E5] py-6 hover:bg-[#F5F5F4] transition-colors

navigation.style: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAFAF9]/80, bottom border border-[#E5E5E5]
navigation.features: Mega-dropdown for Products/Testing, sliding red underline (layoutId via Framer Motion), scroll progress bar in red (#E8302B) under navbar

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-[#FAFAF9] hover:bg-[#E8302B] transition-colors duration-300 px-6 py-3 rounded-none font-medium flex items-center gap-2
buttons.magnetic_effect: Wrap buttons in Framer Motion magnetic hover component
buttons.secondary: border border-[#0A0A0A] text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:text-[#FAFAF9] transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-none

bento_grid.style: Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), tight gap-px bg-[#E5E5E5] border border-[#E5E5E5] to simulate blueprint/technical grid. Items have p-8 bg-[#FAFAF9]

spec_tables.style: font-mono for data, text-sm, border-collapse w-full text-left

gauge_bars.style: Temperature range / performance gauge bars using linear-gradient from #0A0A0A to #E8302B, with a motion.div for fill animation

animations.route_transitions: Fade and slight Y-translate (initial: { opacity: 0, y: 10 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 })
animations.scroll_reveals: whileInView={ opacity: 1, y: 0 } viewport={ once: true, margin: '-100px' }
animations.count_up: Use framer-motion useSpring and useTransform for animated stat counters in dark band sections
animations.marquee: Continuous horizontal scroll strip using framer-motion or react-fast-marquee for industries/credentials
animations.blueprint_svg: Subtle stroke-dashoffset animation on SVG paths for blueprint grid background

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. Rely heavily on grid layouts and flexbox.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn card components. Build custom border-based, zero-radius bento grids using raw HTML elements with Tailwind to ensure a sharp, editorial, and technical feel.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements (buttons, links, form inputs, menus, dropdowns) have robust 'data-testid' attributes mapped to their role.
Implement magnetic buttons and custom scroll/hover reveals using framer-motion.
For the blueprint background, use a faint SVG pattern (e.g., repeating grid) with opacity-10 overlaid on the off-white background.
Implement the sliding nav underline using framer-motion's layoutId property.
Implement count-up stats using framer-motion useSpring for smooth incremental numbers.
For contact forms, utilize react-hook-form + zod. Radix/Shadcn UI inputs are permitted but MUST be customized with sharp edges (rounded-none) and high-contrast borders.
Prefer Phosphor Icons (sharp/regular) or Lucide-React to match the technical/engineering aesthetic.
